# U137: Read back before it’s saved: as Tunde on Wednesday 11 Nov, a goal in CI/CD feeding G-41, 40% to 90%; the Check step says What, Who and where, Measured by, Left as usual and You said as sentences, each whole on a phone; “After you publish” names Thursday 12 Nov and “the plan says 47% for week 47”, and the reviews it joins; “Change” on Left as usual goes to the measure step and “Continue” returns; “Change” on What and another type, then Continue, opens the step that now needs something, and Continue from there comes back; publishing lands on the goal with ?published=1 and History keeps the answer as Checked. (With the rhythm off, “Nothing is due.”, and with Reviews off no review line: when FT builds the switches.)

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-ENTRY-REQUIRED`, `NEW-GOAL-STEPS`
- **Budget:** at most 30 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Tunde, at `/goals/new` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Set-up it takes for granted:**
  - Tunde Bakare (`tunde`) is in Build & Release (`build`) and adds a goal for CI/CD (`cicd`), with himself as its owner, so New goal asks “Tunde is in Build & Release, not CI/CD. Which team is this goal for?” with “Keep it in CI/CD” first ([goal entry](../../core/rules/goal-entry.md), rule 3, `owner-other-team`). The answer is read back under You said, and History keeps it as Checked.
  - G-41 is “Mean time to restore service (P1 and P2)”, a north star, so the goal starts at SVP. Its reviews (Platform leadership weekly and Reliability weekly) are the ones it joins ([the read-back](../../core/rules/read-back.md)).
  - The read-back’s rows are found by their ids (`what`, `who`, `measured`, `usual`, `said`, as [the read-back](../../core/rules/read-back.md) lists them), each row’s sentence by itself; “After you publish” is its own section under that heading.
  - The loop over `Object.entries(want)` checks four rows, word for word: `what` “A number to move: from 40% in week 46 (9–15 Nov 2026) to 90% by week 53 (28 Dec 2026–3 Jan 2027), the same amount each week. Higher is better.”; `who` “Tunde Bakare owns it, in CI/CD. It’s an SVP goal and feeds “Mean time to restore service (P1 and P2)” (G-41).”; `usual` “Whole numbers. From this week to the end of 2026. Steady. Not a guardrail. Helps no other goal.”; `said` “Tunde is in Build & Release; the goal stays in CI/CD.”
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U137

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Tunde (`tunde`).
- _Note:_ Wednesday 11 Nov 2026: week 46, the day before Thursday's review (the spec's worked example).
- Go to `/goals/new` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/what”.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- **Step.** Type “Signed artifacts in staging” into the “Name it the way” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/who”.
- Find and pick: press “Feeds into”, type “G-41”, and choose “Mean time to restore service”.
- Find and pick: press “Team”, type “CI/CD”, and choose “CI/CD”.
- _Note:_ Tunde is in Build & Release: asked, and the answer is read back under You said.
- **Step.** Press the “Keep it in CI/CD” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- **Step.** Type “%” into the “Unit” field.
- **Step.** Type “40” into the “Baseline” field.
- **Step.** Type “90” into the “Target” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- **Check:** “Nothing is saved until you publish.” is shown (else: Check doesn’t say nothing is saved yet).
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Publish goal” button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- For each of `Object.entries(want)`:
  - **Check:** (`finish`) met when `got === text`, where `const rows = p.locator('.goal-read-back')`; `` const rowText = async (id) => ((await rows.locator(`li[data-row="${id}"] .rr-value`).innerText().catch(() => '')) || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() ``; `const got = await rowText(id)`. Else it says: the read-back’s {id} row reads “{got}”, not “{text}”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/^No metric/.test(await rowText('measured'))`, where `const rows = p.locator('.goal-read-back')`; `` const rowText = async (id) => ((await rows.locator(`li[data-row="${id}"] .rr-value`).innerText().catch(() => '')) || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() ``. Else it says: the read-back has no Measured by row.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `after.includes('Its first check-in is due by Thursday 12 Nov, then every week. The first number sets where it stands; the plan says 47% for week 47.')`, where `const after = (await p.locator('.after-publish').innerText().catch(() => '')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')`. Else it says: “After you publish” reads “{after}”.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `after.includes('It joins Platform leadership weekly and Reliability weekly.') && after.includes('Everyone in Example: Platform Engineering can see it.') && after.includes('Until its first check-in you can change anything, or delete it.')`, where `const after = (await p.locator('.after-publish').innerText().catch(() => '')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')`. Else it says: “After you publish” doesn’t say who sees it, the reviews it joins or how long it can be taken back: “{after}”.
- _Note:_ Each sentence is whole: wrapped, never cut to one line with an ellipsis (build review of #129, finding 6).
- **Check:** (`a11y`) met when `!cut && (device !== 'phone' || (!!whoBox && whoBox.height > 30))`, where `const rows = p.locator('.goal-read-back')`; `const cut = await rows.locator('.rr-value').evaluateAll((es) => es.filter((e) => e.scrollWidth > e.clientWidth + 1 || getComputedStyle(e).textOverflow === 'ellipsis' || getComputedStyle(e).whiteSpace === 'nowrap').length)`; `const whoBox = await rows.locator('li[data-row="who"] .rr-value').boundingBox()`. Else it says: the read-back cuts {cut} sentence(s) short (Who and where is {whoBox ? Math.round(whoBox.height) : '?'}px tall).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “check”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Change on Left as usual goes to the measure step; Continue comes straight back.
- **Step.** Press the “Change left as usual” button in New goal’s read-back (the list named “Read back”, a row per topic, each with its id and label) (`.goal-read-back`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) the address matches “/goals/new/check” (else: Continue after Change on Left as usual went to {p.url()}, not back to Check).
- _Note:_ Change on What and another type: Continue opens the step that now needs something (it went dead: build review of #129, finding 1), says what, and Continue from there comes back to Check.
- **Step.** Press the “Change what” button in New goal’s read-back (the list named “Read back”, a row per topic, each with its id and label) (`.goal-read-back`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/what”.
- **Step.** Press the “Hit dated stages” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `opened && await p.locator('.fix-line').first().waitFor({ timeout: 3000 }).then(() => true, () => false)`, where `const opened = /\/goals\/new\/measure(\?|$)/.test(p.url())`. Else it says: Continue after another type stayed on {p.url()} and didn’t open the stages.
- If `opened`:
  - **Step.** Type “Pilot” into the “Stage 1” field.
  - Open the “Stage 1: due” week picker, type “50” and press Enter.
  - **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
  - **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
  - **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/\/goals\/new\/check(\?|$)/.test(p.url()) && (await rowText('what')) === 'Dated stages: 1 stage, the last due week 50 (7–13 Dec 2026).'`, where `const rows = p.locator('.goal-read-back')`; `` const rowText = async (id) => ((await rows.locator(`li[data-row="${id}"] .rr-value`).innerText().catch(() => '')) || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() ``. Else it says: after the stages, Continue went to {p.url()} and What reads “{rowText('what')}”.
- **Step.** Press the “Publish goal” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/…?…published=1”.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!checked && /Which team is this goal for\?/.test(checked.from) && checked.to === 'Keep it in CI/CD'`, where `const snap = await h.snapshot()`; `const made = snap.goals.find((g) => g.title === 'Signed artifacts in staging')`; `const checked = made && snap.changes.find((c) => c.goalId === made.id)?.diffs.find((x) => x.field === 'Checked')`. Else it says: History doesn’t keep the answer as Checked.
- Close this browser.
